comment: Shell commands that make a new artifact from a prompt. A transform takes a named file and returns the same subject changed: background removal, a crop, a resize, ffmpeg on an input. A generator takes a prompt and returns a subject that never existed, and running it again does not reproduce its earlier output. Only generators belong here.
Python regexes, matched case-insensitive. Read by no-silent-substitution and substitution-disclosure-stop.
Add your own generator entry points, one regex per line, in <config>/guardhooks/generator-commands.txt.
